queue.title: The little engines that could: 3 OEMs stand ready to meet EPA's strictest ever NOx limits
queue.excerpt: With the trucking industry bracing for the Environmental Protection Agency’s stringent 2027 emissions regulations , sister companies Volvo Trucks North America and Mack Trucks, along with International Motors, find themselves in a unique position: owners of true 0.035-gram nitrogen oxide (NOx)…
